deals.structure: Non-binding letter of intent: up to $100B of Nvidia investment, progressively with each gigawatt deployed (about $10B per GW, 10 GW of Nvidia systems).
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Never became a definitive agreement. Replaced in Feb 2026 by a $30B equity investment in OpenAI's funding round, not tied to deployment milestones. Reports in March 2026 quote Huang saying the full $100B was 'probably not in the cards'.
deals.notes: Original Sept 2025 press release not re-fetched in this pass; the post-announcement history comes from press. A Yahoo Finance piece describes a 'preliminary deal' for up to $100B more still lingering; unconfirmed.

deals.structure: Equity stake in OpenAI's 2026 funding round (reported $110B announced Feb 27, later grown to ~$122B at ~$852B post-money, closed Mar 31). CNBC reported it was not tied to deployment milestones.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Initial reports (Feb 19) said 'up to $30B' and not final; later coverage describes it as completed, paid in late Feb. Not confirmed in Nvidia's July 10-Q text I could read, which does not name OpenAI in the investment notes.
deals.notes: The 'tranches' lead was not supported; reports describe a single payment. Treat round-size details as press-sourced.

deals.structure: Contingent credit support (land, power, shell) to SB Energy, capped at $105B aggregate, for ~4.25 GW IT load at the PORTS campus, Pike County, Ohio. Site to host Nvidia infrastructure exclusively (limited exceptions) under 20-year leases to an OpenAI-affiliated customer. Each guarantee generally takes effect at lease commencement; first phase expected fiscal 2029. Nvidia also reported to invest $1.5B in SB Energy.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Earlier WSJ-based reports (via Tom's Hardware) said Nvidia was weighing ~$250B guarantee; the signed figure was $105B. As of Q3 FY27 results, Nvidia says no payments have been made under its guarantees; total guarantees reported at $118B at quarter end vs $108.5B at July 26.
deals.notes: Maximum exposure is a cap on a contingent obligation, not cash outlay. Call these residual-value-style/credit guarantees only as press does; the filing describes guarantees of lease/credit obligations. Total maximum gross exposure incl. $3.5B land/power/shell guarantees for AI clouds was $108.5B at Jul 26 (10-Q).

deals.structure: Nvidia partnered with BlackRock, Blackstone, KKR, Apollo, Brookfield and Goldman Sachs on financing platforms targeting more than $500B of third-party funding for AI infrastructure.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Nvidia's share of capital, if any, not disclosed in sources reviewed. On the Nov 17 call, press reports Kress cited these capital partners as a reason Nvidia could be more selective with its own balance sheet.
deals.notes: $500B is a target for third-party money, not Nvidia's commitment.

deals.structure: Nov 2025: Nvidia up to $10B and Microsoft up to $5B in Anthropic, alongside Anthropic's $30B Azure compute commitment. Oct-Nov 2026: per Anthropic's amended S-1, Nvidia agreed to buy about $10B of stock at the IPO price in a concurrent ~$26B private placement with Google, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC; placement closes only if IPO closes.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: 'Up to $10B' became a reported binding ~$10B IPO-price purchase (Nov 19 per WSJ via Seoul Economic Daily). Microsoft's placement stake is reported ~ $1B, not $5B. IPO price reports conflict ($70-78 range vs $83 reported).
deals.notes: Nvidia's Q3 FY27 release says it expanded Anthropic's access to Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin capacity through cloud providers, and mentions no equity. Primary S-1/A not read directly.

deals.structure: Anthropic committed to purchase $30B of Azure compute capacity, with up to 1 GW on Nvidia Grace Blackwell / Vera Rubin systems.
deals.notes: Spend flows to Microsoft, then in part to Nvidia as chip supplier.

deals.structure: Nvidia bought $2B of CoreWeave Class A at $87.20/share to support buildout toward 5 GW by 2030. Earlier: pre-IPO stake and IPO purchase (2025). Stake reported ~9-11.5% (sources conflict); ~10% per WSJ via Seoul Economic Daily.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: CoreWeave stock fell afterwards; Nvidia says CoreWeave needs no 'backstop or bailout' (Huang, per roic.ai summary).

deals.structure: Nvidia agreed to purchase CoreWeave's unsold cloud capacity, up to $6.3B, through April 13, 2032, subject to conditions (conditional capacity purchase, not a debt guarantee).
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: No payment evidence found; Huang disputed a 'backstop' framing.
deals.notes: Figure traces to a CoreWeave SEC filing per search summary; filing itself not fetched. Upgrade to verified once read.

deals.structure: Nvidia reportedly invested $10B in xAI's $20B January 2026 round; SpaceX acquired xAI in Feb 2026 (all-stock, $1.25T), converting the stake to SpaceX shares. Nvidia's 10-Q/13F: ~122.8M Class A shares worth ~$21B at June 30, ~$17.2B on Aug 14, ~130.5M shares ~$19.7B at Sep 30. SpaceX IPO'd in June; Musk said it will build AI services exclusively on Nvidia.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Private xAI equity became public SpaceX shares; carrying value moves with SpaceX stock.
deals.notes: The $10B check is from an unnamed source per CNBC.

deals.structure: Reported 2025 structure: ~$20B SPV buying Nvidia GPUs for xAI ($7.5B equity, $12.5B debt), Nvidia up to $2B of equity.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Could not confirm it closed as described; later reporting focuses on the $10B equity round.
deals.notes: Do not chart as a completed deal.

deals.structure: Nvidia leases back GPU servers from Lambda: ~$1.3B four-year lease for 10,000 servers plus ~$200M for 8,000 more. Lambda reportedly raised a $917M leveraged loan to buy the GPUs.
deals.notes: Nvidia is also a Lambda investor; amount not found.

deals.structure: $5B Intel stock purchase (Sept 2025) alongside product collaboration. Value ~$30B at June 30, 2026, ~$22B in mid-Aug per CNBC; a 13F-based summary says ~$19.4B at Sep 30.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Stake appreciated strongly, then fell; one report says Nvidia trimmed it.
deals.notes: Intel is a supplier/partner, not a primary AI-lab customer; include as a different category.

deals.structure: Announced $2B investment in Nebius (March 2026). A 13F-based figure of ~$281M for the stake looks like a different or partial holding.
deals.notes: Verify via Nebius 6-K or Nvidia release before charting.

deals.structure: Synopsys ~$2B stake (13F ~ $1.9B); Nokia 13F ~ $0.74B after reported cut. Headline of Nokia $1B not confirmed.
deals.notes: Secondary aggregator only; these are vendors/partners, not AI-demand circular loops.

deals.structure: Single analysis: $60M cash for warrants plus $860M five-year rent guarantee (Texas site). Other sources cite GBP500M or $3.1B.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Reported guarantee 'in flux' per FourWeekMBA headline.

deals.structure: Reported $1.5B Nvidia investment in SB Energy alongside the Ohio guarantee and exclusive-supply terms.

Q3 FY27: cloud service agreements $28B plus data-center leases not yet commenced $74B = $102B (from $74B). Separate neocloud agreements $32B, contingent on partner financing/deployment. At Jul 26: cloud service agreements $29B, AI cloud agreements $36B, leases not commenced $25B.
deals.what_changed_since_announcement: Rose in the quarter; Nvidia says neocloud commitments take effect only after partner financing, deployment and acceptance.
deals.notes: Counterparties not named in filing text read. Q3 10-Q delayed ('coming weeks'), so figures come from the CFO commentary.

deals.structure: Participation in rounds; Nvidia's own check sizes not found. Mistral EUR1.7B Series C (Sept 2025, ASML-led) included Nvidia; a TML $2.5B figure is described as in progress.
deals.notes: Wowtale notes amounts are often round totals, not Nvidia's checks.

bull_case_defenses: Huang: circular framing is 'ridiculous'; CoreWeave needs no 'backstop or bailout' (reported, roic.ai summary).

Guarantees only take effect after partner raises its own debt/equity, builds the site and installs compute; they lapse if the project stalls; no payments made to date (Nvidia CFO commentary, Kress on call).
Kress: 'Is it new? No. Did we change anything? No.' (SiliconANGLE); changed communication, not strategy (CNBC).
Scale: Q3 free cash flow $43.8B vs $15.7B equity purchases in the quarter; Nvidia retains ~$227B buyback authorization.
CoreWeave CEO: Nvidia's $2B is ~2% of planned buildout spend (reported).

dropped_leads.reason: Sources describe a single late-February payment, not a tranche schedule; unconfirmed in Nvidia filing text.

dropped_leads.reason: No such statement found in Q3 FY27 release/CFO commentary; revenue is $115.8B/quarter, but nine-month equity purchases of $58.1B are large relative to FCF.
Superseded by $105B signed; $250B was a WSJ/The Information-sourced deliberation, reported unconfirmed.
Could not confirm it closed; replaced in narrative by $10B xAI equity that became SpaceX shares.

open_questions: Nvidia's Q3 FY27 Form 10-Q is delayed ('coming weeks'); full commitments note and named counterparties not yet available.
Revenue share from OpenAI, Anthropic, CoreWeave, xAI/SpaceX as Nvidia customers is not disclosed by name; 10-Q lists only unnamed direct customers (22/14/13/11/10% of receivables at Jul 26).
Whether the Anthropic IPO and ~$10B Nvidia placement closed, and at what price (conflicting reports).
Leadership change: Huang resigned Nov 12, 2026; Kress is interim CEO and CFO. Reports of an SEC investigation (WSJ via CNBC) are unconfirmed by company; treat neutrally.
Q3 cash discrepancy: cash plus marketable debt is $53.5B; including marketable equity ($44.2B) total is ~$97.7B. Specify which when charting.
Reports of pullback from new investments (WSJ via Seoul Economic Daily) conflict with Kress's statement that strategy is unchanged.
